body.title: The team inside the site, on Mistral: seven roles on pipeline-demo (every role on mistral-small-2603)
body.story: The seven roles of "A website with a team inside" (Dinis Cruz, 19 November 2026), each doing its job on a real public site in the family, on Mistral models only. Nothing is pushed to the site: the edit is a proposal for its owner. Every role on mistral-small-2603, to compare with the tiered run.

body.request: Make the page that explains how to ask for a site clearer for a first-time visitor, check it, and offer its opening in Portuguese and French. Report back before anything goes live.

edit.after: The fields you must fill in are:
edit.reason: The heading "The fields" is too vague and does not clearly indicate that these are the fields to be completed.

suggestions.what: Reorder the content into clear sections with headings (e.g., "Site Fields", "Groups", "Privacy Notes")
suggestions.why: A first-time visitor may struggle to parse the dense text without visual separation of topics.

suggestions.what: Convert the "Field Rule" table into a bulleted list with consistent formatting
suggestions.why: Tables can be harder to read quickly than lists, especially on small screens.

suggestions.what: Add spacing between paragraphs and after the "Groups" heading
suggestions.why: The current layout feels cramped, which reduces readability and scannability.
